name: Mario & Sonic at the London 2012 Olympic Games
formal_name: Mario & Sonic at the London 2012 Olympic Games
description:
Distribution of this software ended on Monday, March 31, 2014.

----------------------------------------------

Set at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London, Mario, Sonic, and their friends will take on official Olympic events.
Contains 57 types of events that can be easily played using the unique control method unique to Nintendo 3DS, allowing you to enjoy a variety of events at a fast pace.
Also, if you bring your own console, up to 4 people can play all events together with just one software.
